When deploying sites, enable or disable S3 Lifecycle policies which allow for renders to auto-delete after a certain time. Default is `null`, which does not change any lifecycle policies of the S3 bucket. See: [Lambda autodelete](/docs/lambda/autodelete).

## CLI flag

Use `--enable-folder-expiry` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                         | Flag                     |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| [`remotion lambda sites create`](/docs/lambda/cli/sites/create) | `--enable-folder-expiry` |

## API and configuration references

Follow a reference for the parameter name, default value, and examples in that API or configuration method.

| Reference                                                                  | Name                             |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| [Configuration file](/docs/config#setenablefolderexpiry)                   | `Config.setEnableFolderExpiry()` |
| [`getOrCreateBucket()`](/docs/lambda/getorcreatebucket#enablefolderexpiry) | `enableFolderExpiry`             |
